encodings.scope: Every provision of the Act as printed in the PCO's version 249 as at 10 July 2026 (Parts 1-11, Schedules 1AA, 1-8). Inputs: the Corporation's, Minister's and courts' discretions; regulations; indexed amounts (ss 115-116); minimum weekly earnings; Schedules 2, 3, 3A membership; facts. Carried as text: the provisions listed in each module. NOT encoded: nothing in the Act.
